description: This file defines the ResetPasswordService class responsible for handling password reset processes, including generating reset codes, validating reset URLs, sending reset emails, and managing reset request logs within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ResetPasswordService
classes.description: A service class for managing password reset workflow including code generation, validation, email notification, and persistence related to user password resets within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of EmailService used for sending emails.

methods.name: getResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ResetPasswordDao for database operations related to password reset requests.

methods.name: hasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Calculates the number of days elapsed since the password reset request was created to check expiry.

methods.name: extractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Decodes a reset code and extracts embedded metadata such as username.

methods.name: generateEmailBody
methods.description: Reads an email template file and replaces placeholders with actual values to generate email content.

methods.name: searchForUserRecord
methods.description: Searches for a user record by username, verifying account status and associated employee details.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetEmailBody
methods.description: Creates the body content for password reset email, including generating reset link with URL generator.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the user's work email if the email address is valid.

methods.name: generatePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a secure, encoded reset token including the identifier and random bytes.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Checks if a user is valid and not terminated, returns the user or null.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the reset code URL, ensuring the code's validity and expiry, and retrieves associated user.

methods.name: logPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Logs a password reset request, generates a reset code, and emails it to the user, saving the request.

methods.name: saveResetPassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password and records the reset transaction within a database transaction.
